newsitem.title: CHAD: Chad to raise cotton farmgate price to 194 CFA/kg.
newsitem.headline: Chad to raise cotton farmgate price to 194 CFA/kg.

text.p: Chad is to raise its official farmgate price for top grade seed cotton to 194 CFA francs ($0.3) per kg in 1997/98 (October-April) from 170 CFA francs last season, payable in two instalments, according to a decree issued by the industry ministry.
The price is based on a 16-month average of the Cotlook A index running from January 1, 1997 to April 30, 1998, plus five CFA francs to account for the value of seeds.

Producers will receive an initial payment of 170 CFA for top quality seed cotton. The second payment will be determined according to fluctuations in world cotton lint prices, which means producers may receive more or less than the 24 CFA outstanding.
The decree gave no details on the timing of the second payment.
A committee has just been set up by presidential decree to monitor the cotton sector in Chad, and will draw up proposals for reform.

Chad produced 200,000 tonnes of seed cotton in 1996/97 and exported 80,000 tonnes of cotton lint, compared to 157,500 and 58,000 tonnes respectively in 1995/96. Cotton accounts for 80 percent of the country's total exports.
